prompts: Create {WS}/scene/index.html: a single-file 3D scene with three.js 0.170.0 loaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js (an import map is fine), in low poly or voxel style, showing the classic view of Mount Fuji with the Chureito pagoda (red, five tiers) and cherry trees in bloom in the foreground, with an atmospheric sky (dusk or haze). All geometry must be procedural (no external models or textures). The camera must frame the composition on load; include a subtle animation. This is your ONLY request: there will be no second turn and no answers to questions. Deliver the complete, working final file. Work only inside {WS}.
answers:
[goal] ./scene/index.html: a single-file low-poly three.js 0.170.0 scene of Mt. Fuji, the Chureito pagoda and cherry trees at dusk.

[action] I wrote the file, then fixed one bug. `clock.getDelta()` was being called right after `getElapsedTime()`, which left the animation delta near zero, so I now compute dt from successive elapsed times. I ran `node --check` on the module script.

[result]
- **Not rendered:** I didn't load the page in a browser, so I haven't seen the framing or colors. I also haven't confirmed the CDN import loads. The only check is `SYNTAX_OK` from `node --check`.
- **Setup:** three.js comes from the jsDelivr URL through an import map. All geometry, colors and the sky shader are generated in code, with no external models or textures.
- **Fuji:** a faceted, concave cone with a jagged snow line and a crater disc. It sits behind layered blue foothills, a lake and drifting mist.
- **Pagoda:** five red tiers on a stone base. Each tier has dark roofs with upturned corner tips and glowing windows. It has a gold finial, stone lanterns, a red fence and a flickering warm point light.
- **Trees:** blossoming cherry trees built from pink faceted blobs, placed to frame the left and right edges, plus dark cedars and a few lit houses on the far shore.
- **Sky:** a dusk gradient (indigo to pink to peach) with a low sun glow, stars, and pink cloud streaks. Fog is tinted to match the horizon.
- **Camera:** it is aimed at the pagoda and Fuji from the start. The aspect and FOV are adjusted on resize.
- **Animation:**
  - 700 falling petals.
  - Trees sway slightly.
  - Clouds and mist drift.
  - The camera drifts slowly while keeping the same framing.
  - The lantern light flickers.

[next] Open `scene/index.html` in a browser with internet access. If the pagoda or Fuji sits off-center, adjust `CAM_BASE`, `CAM_TARGET` and `PAGODA_X`/`PAGODA_Z` near the top of the script.
